remaining_limitations: The reporter's four-node TP8 gfx942 deployment, GLM-5.2 weights, and live end-to-end router/backend serving setup were unavailable; no model-semantic, distributed-serving, or gfx942 claim is made.

The prepared host exposed /root/.cargo/bin in PATH but denied this job user access. An isolated pinned Rust 1.90 toolchain was installed under /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-f7ef115a11c1 for independent compilation.

The candidate intentionally continues to reject tool type spellings outside Python's current 12-value RESPONSE_TOOL_TYPES allowlist. This is consistent with the current Python contract, while additional fields on accepted types are preserved.
